slides.title: Ethiopia MPs raise civilian safety in parliament

slides.text: On **Nov 26**, two opposition MPs questioned **PM Abiy Ahmed** on **civilian insecurity** in parliament, **Addis Standard** reports.
**MP Aweke Hamzaye** cited **Ethiopian Human Rights Commission** findings and blamed abuses on government forces, armed groups and others.
**MP Gebremeskel Ademe** asked how **displaced residents** will return and be protected, and about **investigations** and legal action.
**Protect civilians, investigate abuses.** Follow for sourced updates from across Ethiopia.

source: Source: Addis Standard via AllAfrica; Fana (state media), Nov 26, 2026
